# Data Split

```{r}
set.seed(2024)

db_ml <- db

# db_ml <- db %>%

# trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$ID, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$Group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trn <- db_ml[trnIndex,]
tst <- db_ml[-trnIndex,]

trn[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(trn[-c(1,2)]))
tst[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(tst[-c(1,2)]))
```




# Multinomial logistic regression with neural networks

```{r, message=FALSE}

set.seed(2024)

search_grid <- expand.grid(
  decay = seq(0, 0.2, by = 0.01)
)

train_control <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats=3)

multi_model <- train(Group ~ .,
                  data = trn[-1], 
                  method = "multinom",
                  tuneGrid = search_grid,
                  preProcess = c("pca"),
                  trControl = train_control,
                  trace = FALSE)

plot(multi_model)



pred_multi_model <- data.frame(Prediction = predict(multi_model, newx = as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type="raw"))

trn_class_res <- data.frame(ID = trn$ID, Prediction = pred_multi_model, Reference = trn$Group)

confusionMatrix(predict(multi_model), trn$Group, positive = "DNML1")
varImp(multi_model)

confint(multi_model$finalModel)

# Extract the PCA model
preproc <- preProcess(trn[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca"))


pca_transformed <- predict(preProcess(trn[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca")), trn[-c(1,2)])
pca_transformed <- data.frame(pca_transformed, Group = trn$Group)


# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC1) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC1) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC2) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC2) + 1

# Generate grid points
grid <- expand.grid(PC1 = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                    PC2 = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))


# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data, original_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')
original_feature_names <- names(trn)[-c(1,2)]

# Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid, trn[original_feature_names])
colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names

# Predict on the original feature space
grid_original$Group <- predict(svm_model, grid_original, type = "raw")


# Plot the decision boundary
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group), size = 2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "SVM Decision Boundary with PCA",
       x = "Principal Component 1",
       y = "Principal Component 2") +
  theme_minimal() 




############################################################################################################################################

# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC3) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC3) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC4) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC4) + 1
```

# Naive Bayes

```{r}
search_grid <- expand.grid(
  usekernel = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  laplace = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  adjust = seq(1, 5, by = 1)
)

train_control <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats=3)

nb_model <- train(Group ~ .,
                  data = trn[-1], 
                  method = "naive_bayes",
                  trControl = train_control, 
                  preProcess = c("pca"),
                  tuneGrid = search_grid)

plot(nb_model)

pred_gnb <- predict(nb_model, as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type = "raw")

confusionMatrix(pred_gnb, trn$Group, positive = "DNM1L")
```

# SVM

```{r}
set.seed(2024)


# Define training control with repeated cross-validation
train_control <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 10, repeats = 3)

# Preprocess with PCA and train SVM model
svm_model <- train(Group ~ ., 
                   data = trn[-1], 
                   method = "svmLinear",
                   preProcess = c("pca"),
                   trControl = train_control,
                   tuneLength = 10) 


pred_svm <- predict(svm_model, as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type = "raw")

confusionMatrix(pred_svm, trn$Group, positive = "DNM1L")

# Extract the PCA model
preproc <- preProcess(trn[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca"))


pca_transformed <- predict(preProcess(trn[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca")), trn[-c(1,2)])
pca_transformed <- data.frame(pca_transformed, Group = trn$Group)


# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC1) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC1) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC2) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC2) + 1

# Generate grid points
grid <- expand.grid(PC1 = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                    PC2 = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))


# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data, original_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')
original_feature_names <- names(trn)[-c(1,2)]

# Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid, trn[original_feature_names])
colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names

# Predict on the original feature space
grid_original$Group <- predict(svm_model, grid_original, type = "raw")


# Plot the decision boundary
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group), size = 2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "SVM Decision Boundary with PCA",
       x = "Principal Component 1",
       y = "Principal Component 2") +
  theme_minimal() 




############################################################################################################################################

# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC3) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC3) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC4) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC4) + 1

# Generate grid points
grid <- expand.grid(PC3 = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                    PC4 = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))


# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data, original_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')

colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names
```

```{r}
grid_original$Group <- predict(svm_model, grid_original, type = "raw")

# Plot the decision boundary
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group), size = 2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "SVM Decision Boundary with PCA",
       x = "Principal Component 1",
       y = "Principal Component 2") +
  theme_minimal()

###############################################################################################################################################

############################################################################################################################################

# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC3) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC3) + 1
y_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC4) - 1
y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC4) + 1

# Generate grid points
grid <- expand.grid(PC3 = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                    PC4 = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))


# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data, original_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')
original_feature_names <- names(tst)[-c(1,2)]

# Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid, tst[original_feature_names])
colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names

# Predict on the original feature space
grid_original$Group <- predict(svm_model, grid_original, type = "raw")

# Plot the decision boundary
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, color = Group), size = 2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = PC3, y = PC4, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "SVM Decision Boundary with PCA",
       x = "Principal Component 3",
       y = "Principal Component 4") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
preproc <- preProcess(tst[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca"), pcaComp = 3)

pca_transformed <- data.frame(pca_transformed, Group = tst$Group)

# Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
x_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC1) - 1
x_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC1) + 1

y_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC2) + 1
z_min <- min(pca_transformed$PC3) - 1
z_max <- max(pca_transformed$PC3) + 1

# Generate dense grid points
grid_points <- expand.grid(PC1 = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 50),
                           PC2 = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 50),
                           PC3 = seq(z_min, z_max, length.out = 50))

# Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data) {
  center <- pca_model$mean
  scale <- pca_model$std
  rotation <- pca_model$rotation
  
  # Calculate the original data matrix
  original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation[, 1:ncol(pca_data)])
  
  # Re-scale and re-center
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
  original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
  
  return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
}

# Get the original feature names (excluding 'Group')
original_feature_names <- names(tst)[-c(1,2)]

# Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid_points)
colnames(grid_original) <- original_feature_names
```
